# Status

The current release is `0.8.1`, a source release at that Git tag; nothing is on a registry. The [changelog](https://github.com/beyond10x/inference/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) records every change a consumer can see. **Shipped** means in a release, with a test on `main` that holds it: an item that says "Since" is in that release and every one after it. **Planned** means not built. What is on `main` and in no release yet is not counted as shipped; it is listed under [On main, in the next release](#on-main-in-the-next-release). Checked on 2026-10-23: 35 shipped, 12 planned, and 0 on main for the next release.

Nothing yet: everything on `main` is in `0.8.1`.

## The test behind each item

The generator refuses an item whose test is missing or ignored. A live acceptance is held by live tests instead: they call the provider, need its credentials, and are ignored by default, so they run only when asked for.
